title: Vecākais Front-end programmatūras inženieris / Senior Software Engineer (Front-End)

summary.lv: ARRISE meklē vecāko front-end inženieri ar pieredzi React, TypeScript un Canvas, lai izstrādātu modernas tīmekļa lietotnes un saskarnes iGaming jomā.
summary.en: ARRISE seeks a senior front-end engineer experienced in React, TypeScript, and Canvas to build modern web applications and interfaces in the iGaming domain.
